rulesTestNames: admits the owner and a whole-programme guest relations duty only
lists one programme's rows by a query naming it, and denies writes
read: get and list (a query naming programId, and the kind) for the programme owner and a live guest relations duty covering the whole programme, from the account's programAccessViews programAll map; never while deleted
write: server only; written from programGuests (with their workspace field assertions), programFunctionGuests, programHouseholds and programGuestGroups
migrationNotes: Replaces listProgramGuests for the Host app (#2306): the guest list, the guest desk and the programme inbox audience read these rows through Firestore. The callable stays deployed for released Host builds and retires under #2174. The program-guest-directory-views copy-forward migration creates rows for guests, households and groups that predate the triggers and refreshes programAccessViews so staff views carry programAll.

The Nov 2026 server-trust decision (#1339) kept this read a callable because the phone numbers and emails come from the workspace field assertions. The trigger now does that resolution, so the assertions and the field authority stay server-only and the row holds only the values the callable returned. No client read the field authority.
Personal data (guest names, phone numbers and emails): archive anonymization and guest deletion rewrite or delete the rows through the source triggers; nothing else to scrub.
